newsitem.title: USA: Playboy rises on rosy Q2 outlook-analysts.
newsitem.headline: Playboy rises on rosy Q2 outlook-analysts.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc's stock rose after the company said Thursday it expects fiscal 1997 second-quarter December 31 per-share earnings of about $0.14, compared to $0.06 in the year-ago period.

"This is a big surprise. And because the stock is (somewhat) illiquid, any good news accentuates the move," said Gruntal & Co analyst Rita Zanella, who is raising her second- quarter estimate from $0.08 a share to be in line with Playboy's forecast.
Playboy, an international media and entertainment company, was trading at 10-3/4, up 1-1/8.
Playboy attributed its strength to increases in entertainment and catalog operating profit and growth in the international publishing business.
"It's really a strong international story for Playboy," said Zanella, who added she will be adjusting her full-year $0.32 a share estimate for the company.
